identity_marker: modern BMW 3 Series G20 vehicle with digital iDrive screen, gold Castrol Edge 5W-30 LL-01 bottle, and red plastic funnel
continuity_anchors: brightly lit garage environment with clean concrete floors and soft overhead studio lighting
video_goal: Demonstrate how to check the electronic oil level and top up the engine oil using Castrol Edge 5W-30 LL-01 in a BMW 3 Series (G20).
single_prompt: From an over-the-shoulder view, a hand presses the engine start/stop button on the dashboard to turn on the vehicle's electronics. The camera smoothly transitions to a close-up as a hand rotates the iDrive controller dial, selecting 'Car', then 'Vehicle status', and finally clicking on 'Engine oil level' on the central display screen. Pushing in for a direct close-up, the screen displays a digital engine graphic with a yellow bar indicating the oil level is below the 'Max' line. Gliding down to a low angle close-up, a hand pulls the '2x' hood release lever twice in quick succession. Shifting to a first-person view, hands lift the front hood, revealing the longitudinal engine layout and plastic engine cover. Moving into a close-up, fingers grip the circular oil filler cap on top of the engine cover, twist it counter-clockwise, and lift it off. Transitioning to a high angle close-up, a clean, red plastic funnel is inserted directly into the open oil filler hole on the engine block. Pulling back to an eye-level medium shot, hands hold the gold Castrol Edge 5W-30 LL-01 bottle, twist off the red plastic cap, and peel back the silver foil seal. Moving to an over-the-shoulder close-up, the bottle is tilted, pouring a steady stream of amber oil into the red funnel. Shifting to a tight close-up, the funnel is lifted out of the hole, and a blue microfiber cloth wipes away a small drip from the rim of the filler neck. Maintaining a close-up angle, the oil filler cap is placed back onto the hole and twisted clockwise until a distinct click is visually registered by the hand stopping. Smoothly pulling back to a wide shot, hands pull the hood down and drop it from about a foot high to securely latch it shut. Transitioning back inside for a direct close-up, the screen updates, showing the digital oil level bar filling up to the green 'Max' line with an 'OK' status.
